indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Gained about 173 points, winning back most of last week's 2.7% loss.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Led the rally as chipmakers rebounded, adding about 674 points.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Jumped 1,104 points in a broad advance.

notes: The AI trade bounced back after last week's sell-off: chip stocks led, with AMD up about 12% on an analyst upgrade, and the small-cap Russell 2000 rose about 3%.
Nvidia fell about 4% after its board opened an investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang, trimming a loss that reached about 8% early in the day.
Oil slid after President Trump said new strikes on Iran were unlikely while talks continue: December WTI fell about 4.5% to near $86.75, and the VIX dropped about 22% to just under 20.
events: Tue 10 Nov, 16:30 Kuwait time: US October consumer price index (CPI); forecasts call for a 0.3% monthly rise.
Wed 11 Nov: Veterans Day; stock markets open, bond market closed.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision.

sources.title: JKN: Wall Street rallies, all three indices rise
